speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: In the coming years, the Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF) will continue to strengthen our partnership with the community in order to nurture resilient individuals, strong families and a caring society.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: To give every child a good start in life, we will press on with the transformation of the early childhood sector, so that more families can benefit from accessible, affordable and good quality early childhood services.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We will expand full-day preschool places to provide a place for every child who needs one.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: To support sustainable growth of this sector, the Early Childhood Development Agency will work closely with industry partners and the National Institute of Early Childhood Development to ensure that our early childhood educators have meaningful and rewarding careers.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We will also make good use of training and technology to raise standards and productivity.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: For children from low-income families, we will develop a strong ecosystem of support through the KidSTART pilot.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We will partner parents to enable their children to develop holistically in the familiar settings of their home and preschool.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We must continue to make Singapore one of the best places to build strong families and bring up children.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: Together with our community partners, we will foster a family-friendly environment and share the joys of marriage and parenthood.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We will provide marriage preparation and support programmes through our community partners, so that couples and families are equipped to build strong relationships.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We will also continue to provide resources to support parents in caring for and bonding with their children.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: Even as we pursue these, we recognise that some marriages may not work out.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: Our network of Social Service Offices (SSOs) has brought help closer to those in need.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We will continue to tackle our social challenges by enhancing social service delivery on the ground.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: Through the SSOs, we will strengthen our partnerships and processes across agencies and community partners to provide more holistic, client-centric support.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We aim to help clients receive assistance and apply for multiple help schemes more conveniently, no matter which agency they first approach.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We will also channel Government, private sector and community resources to yield greater and more long-lasting impact.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: By significantly tightening processes and improving coordination, we will ease the burden on clients, and better help them to get back on their feet.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We will support youths-at-risk with opportunities to succeed in life, by intervening more aggressively upstream, and adopting a more preventive, rehabilitative and integrative approach towards youths-at-risk, youth offenders and their families.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: Through our new Integrated Service Providers, we will provide youths-at-risk and youth offenders with programmes that are better tailored to their needs and delivered with greater consistency.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: This will raise the quality of youth programmes and better help our youths achieve positive outcomes in life.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: With SG Enable, we will continue to implement the Third Enabling Masterplan to empower persons with disabilities to live their lives to their fullest potential.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: For children with developmental needs, we will intervene early and tailor support services to best help them in their growing years.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: As persons with disabilities progress through different stages of life, we will provide more seamless support, such as by easing the transition from school to work.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: To enhance opportunities for employment and lifelong learning, we will prepare and equip persons with disabilities to be effective at the workplace, and work closely with employers to build an inclusive company culture.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We will also support caregivers to ensure their well-being and peace of mind, with regard to the care of their loved ones.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We will care for our seniors, who continue to enrich our society with their wisdom and experience.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We will support and encourage Singaporeans to plan ahead to safeguard and unlock their assets with a Lasting Power of Attorney, in the event that they lose mental capacity.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: For those who have lost mental capacity, and have no family to help, we will empower credible and trustworthy members of the community to step in to support.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: In doing so, we hope that Singaporeans can enter their silver years with confidence and peace of mind.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We will continue to enhance comprehensive support for children who experience abuse and neglect.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: This includes intervention to support families to make the home environment safer for children, and expanding foster care so that children who cannot be with their biological families can still grow up in a family environment.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: Through the National Council of Social Service (NCSS), we will continue to develop the social service sector, as they are vital partners in our mission to uplift and protect vulnerable individuals and families.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: Over the years, VWOs, corporates, community organisations, social service professionals and many Singaporeans have stepped forward to extend a helping hand to people in need.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: In line with the SG Cares movement, we will further nurture this spirit of giving.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We will also champion social innovation and enterprise and enable more consistent and sustainable giving by individuals and corporates.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: These efforts will actualise and amplify the goodwill in society.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: Creating a more cohesive society is a continuous endeavour over the long term.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We invite all Singaporeans to partner us in this journey to strengthen our society and improve the lives of others, as we work towards a better future together.
